visual_enhancers.item_names: Use high contrast text (darkText #1A1A1A) and semibold/medium weight to make items legible from 50-80cm away.
visual_enhancers.amount: Highlight the amount with darkText (#1A1A1A) and bold (700) weight instead of extrabold (800) and gray. High contrast is key here.
visual_enhancers.variants_addons: Remove italic formatting for better readability. Use font-medium and grayText (#666666) but bumped up to text-xs.
visual_enhancers.item_notes: Use primaryOrange (#F26B33) or a darker shade and medium weight to make kitchen notes easily noticeable.
visual_enhancers.hierarchy: Ensure clear distinction between Item Name (primary, larger, darker) and its details (secondary, slightly smaller, gray).

grids.card_width: Card width fits in a column grid, typically 200-300px wide. No structure changes required.

layouts.item_row: Maintain the flex row layout. Ensure proper line heights for the enlarged text (e.g., leading-tight for variants).

motion.micro_interactions: Keep existing hover and state transitions for action buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio meets minimum WCAG AA standard (4.5:1 for normal text). The shift from #666666 to #1A1A1A for item names and amount fixes contrast failures against the white/light background.
accessibility.legibility: Target audience reads from a distance of 50-80cm. Increasing base font size from 9px/11px to 12px/15px solves the primary complaint.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements already have data-testid attributes; maintain this standard for any new wrappers if created.

instructions_to_main_agent: In /app/frontend/src/components/cards/OrderCard.jsx, apply the following targeted typography fixes:

1. Replace the amount styling: Change `<span className="font-extrabold text-lg ..." style={{ color: COLORS.grayText }}>` to `<span className="font-bold text-lg md:text-xl flex-shrink-0 ml-2" style={{ color: COLORS.darkText }}>`.
2. Fix item names: Change `<span className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: COLORS.grayText }}>` to `<span className="text-[15px] font-semibold leading-tight" style={{ color: COLORS.darkText }}>`.

3. Fix variants/addons: Change `<div className="text-[9px] leading-tight italic" style={{ color: COLORS.grayText }}>` to `<div className="text-xs font-medium leading-tight mt-0.5" style={{ color: COLORS.grayText }}>`.
4. Fix item notes: Change `<div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] leading-tight">` to use `text-xs font-medium` and switch text color to `COLORS.primaryOrange` for visibility.
5. Do NOT use font weight 800 (extrabold) anywhere in the file. Replace with font-bold (700) where needed.
6. Do NOT change the layout structure, action button logic, or permissions. Focus purely on className and style properties related to font-size, font-weight, color, and spacing for text legibility.
